sources.entry: pyenv-win - A Python version manager for Windows (rbenv-win fork).

summary.one_liner: pyenv-win is a Windows port of pyenv that lets you install, switch between, and manage multiple Python versions from PowerShell or the command prompt.
summary.what_it_does: The tool provides a pyenv-style command set (install, uninstall, global, local, shell, versions, which, whence, rehash, exec, update) for Windows. It installs Python versions from a list of supported releases via `pyenv install -l`, and lets you pick a global default or a per-folder local version via a .python-version file. Shims are generated so the selected python and pip-installed executables resolve correctly, and `pyenv rehash` refreshes them after changes. It is forked from rbenv-win and offers several install routes, including PowerShell script, Git, zip, pip, and Chocolatey. A 64-bit train (2.64.x, master) and a 32-bit train (2.32.x) are maintained as separate releases.
use_cases: manage multiple Python versions on Windows
switch the default Python version globally
set a different Python version for a specific project folder
install an older Python version side by side with a newer one
list and filter available Python releases for Windows
use a pyenv-like workflow on Windows instead of Linux or macOS
how_to_run: Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri "<installer URL>" -OutFile "./install-pyenv-win.ps1"; &"./install-pyenv-win.ps1" (run in PowerShell; the URL is truncated in the README)
Reopen PowerShell and run `pyenv --version` to verify
`pyenv install -l` to list supported Python versions
`pyenv global 3.5.2` to set the default version
`pyenv rehash` after installing packages or switching versions
notable: Forked from rbenv-win and adapted from the pyenv project for Windows
Supports 64-bit by default, with a separate 32-bit release train
Multiple install routes: PowerShell script, Git, zip, pip, Chocolatey
Per-folder local Python version selection via .python-version
caveats: Windows only; the README does not describe other platforms
Windows 10 1905+ may require disabling the built-in Python launcher app aliases
Versions below 2.4 of pyenv-win have been dropped because their installers do not install cleanly
